_about: People masked as [PERSON_n] before any AI call (FR-26, Masking_Lite_Spec §2). Drafted 14 Oct 2026 by scanning every document and note (main + held-out) for capitalised name pairs, then checked by hand: no job titles, places, companies or legal terms. First names are listed only where the dataset uses them on their own. Clients and contractors who are deal counterparties (Daniel Ortiz, Marcus Reed…) are masked as [CLIENT_n] from deals.json / register.json instead. Third-party companies named in notes and schedules (vendors, prospects, competing platforms) are listed under companies and masked as [CLIENT_n]. Product and tool names (PipeKit, IngestIQ, DocuSign, NetSuite) stay visible. Law firms (Calloway Stern, Mehta Rao) are not client data and are left visible. TO BE CONFIRMED by KaVi before the first masked model call.
